name: Taxonomy Bootstrap Accordion
description: Creates a block that has a bootstrap accordion representation of all taxonomy items that are not open tags.
project_description:
Provides a Bootstrap accordion for taxonomy vocabularies. When placing your block, select the vocabularies you want to include in your block. Each vocabulary name will be the panel heading and its terms will appear below it when expanded.

 This module is compatible only with Bootstrap 3 since significant changes were made between version 2 and 3. It has only been tested with the Bootstrap theme and no other theme using Bootstrap.

 9/10 Version 
 The module is feature complete. The only requirements are taxonomy and Bootstrap theme .
